purpose: Technology-neutral product specification and control point for an AI builder
start: Read AGENTS.md, docs/specifications/12-BRANCH-SAFETY-AND-VISUAL-EVIDENCE.md, and docs/specifications/00-PROJECT-INDEX.md, then use AI-BUILDER-START-PROMPT.md.
main_policy: main is a read-only specification/control point for AI builders unless the user explicitly names main and specifies the exact intended specification change.
design_gate: The builder must present at least four genuinely different UI/UX concepts and receive user approval before choosing the final stack and building the production UI.
planning_policy: Use high reasoning effort and provide Recommended, Optional, and Experimental suggestions with benefits and tradeoffs.
visual_policy: Use highest-quality practical images; store concepts, approved design, and actual final application screenshots under design images/.
launch_policy: Open directly into the main workspace; do not create login, welcome, marketing, onboarding, blocking splash, or mandatory setup pages.
stack_policy: No technology stack is prescribed by this repository.
